g.text: Tokens to dollars: a Sydney team of 1,000
Claude Opus 5.5 on the au. profile: ~$4.40 per million input tokens, ~$22 per million output (list + ~10% regional)
50,000 requests over an 8-hour day ≈ 104 per minute
plan 2–3× for peaks, and keep max_tokens tight
Cheaper option: Sonnet 5.5 at $2 / $10 is ≈ $2,500 a day uncached, but in Sydney it's on global. only (at launch), so processing can leave Australia.
Every number here is an assumption you can swap: tokens × price for the bill, (input + 5 × output) per minute for the quota.
